note: PostFinance's prices for private customers (as at 1 July 2026): its Visa Classic Card's main card costs 50 francs a year, free with a first card in the SmartPlus, SmartYoung or SmartStudents packages, which the game's Smart package isn't, and interest on a part-payment is 9.5% a year.
